Bathroom Remodeling in El Dorado, KS

El Dorado is where Wheatland Construction lives and works — our home base in Butler County since 2018. We know El Dorado's housing stock intimately, from the oil-era homes near the downtown corridor that were built when Butler County was producing oil for the nation, to the post-war ranches along Central and Main, to the newer builds east toward the lake. Every era has its bathroom challenges, and we've worked in all of them.

El Dorado bathrooms span nearly a century of construction. The 1940s homes near downtown may have original cast-iron fixtures and galvanized supply that's been in service for 80+ years. The mid-century ranches have the standard 1960s–1970s bathroom that looks exactly like every other 1960s–1970s bathroom. The 1990s–2000s builds east of town have the builder-grade fiberglass surround and cultured marble vanity combination that has reliably aged poorly.

We remodel all of them. And because El Dorado is home, we give our El Dorado clients the same honest assessment and quality standard we'd want for our own homes.

El Dorado Bathroom Remodeling by Era

Pre-1950 downtown homes: Cast-iron plumbing, original tile (sometimes hexagonal mosaic), galvanized supply, claw-foot tub rough-in. These are interesting bathrooms that deserve careful assessment before any decisions. We camera-inspect drains, check supply line condition, and tell you what needs to be updated versus what can stay. Character preservation matters here — we don't gut historic El Dorado bathrooms without reason.

Post-war ranches (1950s–1970s): Original fiberglass surrounds replaced with proper tile, new vanities and fixtures, updated exhaust ventilation, permitted plumbing. These are the bread-and-butter bathroom remodels in El Dorado.

1990s–2000s construction near the lake: Builder-grade failures at 20–25 years — crazed fiberglass, cultured marble cracking, original fixtures. Material upgrade scope: tile shower, quartz or solid-surface vanity top, new fixtures.

Waterproofing in El Dorado Bathrooms

The Walnut River and El Dorado Lake influence the local water table east of town. While this primarily affects basements, it also means that improperly waterproofed shower installations in homes near the lake can have subfloor moisture issues sooner than in drier locations. We use membrane waterproofing systems on all tile shower builds — not just cement board.

Permits in El Dorado

City of El Dorado Building Department for homes inside city limits. Butler County for rural properties. We handle all permitting.

How We Approach Bathroom Remodeling in

Every bathroom remodel in starts with an in-person assessment. We walk the existing bathroom with you, look at what's behind the walls where it matters (around the tub/shower surround, under the vanity, at the subfloor where it meets the tub), and give you an honest read on what the project actually involves before any numbers get discussed.

We price in writing. Every line item - demo, plumbing, tile, vanity, fixtures, exhaust, permit - is documented before work starts. No surprises mid-project.

Our crew handles demo through final walkthrough. We don't hand off your project to a rotating cast of subcontractors who don't know each other's work. The people who pull the permits are the people who do the work and stand behind it.

Wheatland Construction has held Veterans Approved Builder status (ID: 00899) since we opened and has been Home Advisor Certified since 2019. We're licensed and insured in Kansas. If something isn't right at the final walkthrough, we fix it before we consider the project done.

Frequently Asked Questions About Bathroom Remodeling in El Dorado

How much does bathroom remodeling cost in El Dorado, KS?

El Dorado bathroom remodels range from $7,500 for a basic guest bath refresh to $30,000+ for a full primary bath renovation in an older downtown home with plumbing updates. Written, line-item estimates.

Can I remodel the bathroom in my older El Dorado home without completely replacing the plumbing?

Depends on the condition. We assess before pricing. In many older El Dorado homes, the drain lines and supply lines are in good enough condition to leave in place. In others, the practical answer is to update them during the remodel rather than risk failure after the tile is set. We'll tell you honestly what we find.

Who handles permits for bathroom remodeling in El Dorado?

City of El Dorado Building Department for in-city properties. Butler County for rural properties. We handle all permit applications.

Do you do walk-in shower conversions in El Dorado?

Yes — this is one of the most common scopes in El Dorado's post-war ranch homes. We remove the original tub/shower combo, frame the shower enclosure, apply membrane waterproofing, tile, and install appropriate fixtures. Everything permitted.

How long does a bathroom remodel take in El Dorado?

2–4 weeks for most projects. Older homes with plumbing infrastructure work or full tile builds may run 3–5 weeks.

Does bathroom remodeling add value in El Dorado?

Yes. Butler County real estate has strengthened and El Dorado's market is active. Updated bathrooms improve appraised value, particularly in the older home inventory where buyers discount for deferred maintenance.
